title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Claim Settlement Conditions
content:
These are the settlement conditions of the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own). Each coverage is settled separately from the latest governing adjuster report on the claim, with its own deductible.

**S1 — actual cash value building settlement.** On a tier whose building settlement basis is actual cash value the building payable is the actual cash value loss less the building deductible, never below zero, capped at the building limit.

**S2 — replacement cost building settlement.** On a tier whose building settlement basis is replacement cost the building loss is taken at replacement cost.

**S3 — required insurance.** When coinsurance applies the required insurance is the lower of the tier's coinsurance percentage of the replacement cost value and the tier's building limit per unit times the number of units. *For a building amount sworn on a building proof of loss this clause is no longer in force as written; for a building payment and for every other settlement the required insurance remains measured against the replacement cost value shown on the policy.*

**S4 — coinsurance penalty.** When the building limit is at least the required insurance, the building payable is the replacement cost loss less the deductible, never below zero, capped at the building limit; when it is less, the building payable is the replacement cost loss multiplied by the building limit divided by the required insurance and rounded to the cent, less the deductible, never below zero, capped at the building limit.

**S5 — contents.** Contents are always settled at actual cash value less the contents deductible, never below zero, capped at the contents limit, and cover only the property described by the tier's contents owner basis. *For a contents amount sworn on a contents proof of loss this clause is no longer in force; every other contents settlement remains at actual cash value less the contents deductible, never below zero, capped at the contents limit.*

**S6 — ICC and loss avoidance.** Increased Cost of Compliance is paid up to the tier's ICC limit without a deductible only on a community's substantial-damage determination, and loss-avoidance supplies up to the tier's loss-avoidance limit without a deductible.

**S7 — unit owners.** A unit owner's own Dwelling Form policy never reduces what the RCBAP pays.

**S8 — new payments.** A new payment on a coverage is the payable amount less what has already been paid net of voids on that claim and coverage, issued only when positive. *This clause is no longer in force for a building payment or a contents payment; every other coverage's new payment remains the payable amount less what has already been paid net of voids on that claim and coverage.*

**S9 — payees and voids.** Building payments name the mortgagee of record when the tier names the mortgagee on building payments. A void reverses one issued payment item in full by its payment reference and the voided amount is reissued under a new payment reference.

The settlement basis, coinsurance percentage and ICC limit each clause reads are the tier's own figures in the product's loss settlement and limits schedules.

## Coinsurance penalty worked through (hypothetical RCBAP building)

Replacement cost value 1,000,000; 5 units; coinsurance percentage 80; per-unit amount 250,000; building limit 600,000; replacement cost loss 100,000; deductible 5,000. Required insurance: the lower of 800,000 and 1,250,000, which is 800,000. The limit is below it, so the loss is multiplied by 600,000 and divided by 800,000, giving 75,000.00; less the deductible, 70,000.00; within the limit, so 70,000.00 is payable.

superseded_clauses: when coinsurance_applies the required insurance is the lower of coinsurance_pct of the replacement_cost_value and building_limit_per_unit times the number_of_units.
A new payment on a coverage is the payable amount less what has already been paid net of voids on that claim and coverage (nfipcom_msr_claim_part_paid), issued only when positive;
